team_strength.attribution: JGravier, soccer-elo, compiled from eloratings.net World Football Elo Ratings, https://github.com/JGravier/soccer-elo
team_strength.method_note: Yearly (Dec 31) Elo ratings. For a match in year Y, each team is assigned its rating from the most recent year strictly before Y, guaranteeing no post-kickoff information leaks in regardless of the match date within Y. fifa_rank and pre_match_win_odds are left blank -- FIFA rankings did not exist before 1992 and no betting-odds source is used, so those columns are not fabricated.
team_strength.coverage_note: Verified to resolve all 1928 (match, team) pairs across the 964-match historical roster with zero missing values.

focal_team_strength.method_note: World Football Elo ratings as of the day before Match 95: Argentina 2151, Egypt 1747. Same rating family as the historical JGravier compilation; stored as a compact source-linked snapshot.

pmsr_2026.metric: Total Penalties (awarded, from the official 'Set Plays' table -- includes scored, saved, and missed penalty kicks; not the same quantity as 'penalty goals scored').
pmsr_2026.matches_covered: 96 of 96 played matches through the Round of 16 (full census at time of retrieval, not a sample).
pmsr_2026.extraction_method: Each match's official PMSR PDF was downloaded and its 'Set Plays' pages (one per team) parsed for the 'Total Penalties' figure. 9 of 96 matches (M06, M09, M10, M31, M33, M34, M55, M59, M78) initially failed extraction because the team-name regex did not include non-ASCII letters (Turkiye/Curacao/Cote d'Ivoire); re-extracted with a locale-aware pattern and verified against the source PDF text. All 96 matches resolved -- no matches were dropped or excluded.
pmsr_2026.vendored_pdfs: Only Argentina's 5 matches (M19, M43, M70, M86, M95) are kept as raw PDFs under data/raw/fifa/pmsr_2026/ -- the other 91 source PDFs (~500MB total) are not vendored; their per-match figures are preserved in the raw extraction CSV with the exact source_url per row for independent re-verification.
pmsr_2026.comparability_note: This 2026 figure ('penalties awarded' from the official Set Plays table, one in-progress tournament, teams have played 3-5 matches depending on group/knockout path) is NOT directly comparable to the 1930-2022 'penalty_goals_scored' figure computed in discipline.py from the Fjelstul database (a different quantity -- scored only, not awarded -- across 22 completed tournaments). Report side by side; do not merge into a single combined statistic or a single percentile.

scenario_only.assumption: Conditional timing grid based on conflicting public reports; no claim that allowing the goal was the correct decision.
